claims.text: Villa Dubrovnik is perched on a cliff, with views of the island of Lokrum and the Old Town.

findings.quote: Perched on a cliff with its distinctive architecture, Hotel Villa Dubrovnik embodies the essence of its city. It beautifully contrasts and, at the same time, harmonizes with
offering its guests a wonderful view of the island of Lokrum and the Old Town.

claims.text: The building was designed in 1961 by architect Mladen Frka as a residence for members of political elites in Dubrovnik's Sveti Jakov area.

findings.quote: Hotel Villa Dubrovnik was designed in 1961 as a residential building for members of political elites in the prestigious location of Dubrovnik Sveti Jakov area by architect Mladen Frka.

claims.text: In 1963 the building became an annex to Hotel Argentina.

findings.quote: Its function was changed in 1963 when it became an annex to Hotel Argentina

claims.text: Room interiors were designed by Studio Arthur Casas.

findings.quote: All of them offer outstanding comfort and immaculate interiors designed by Studio Arthur Casas.

claims.text: The hotel displays works by local Croatian painters and sculptors such as Ivana Pegan, Dubravka Tullio and Ivo Dimnic.

findings.quote: you will encounter and discover the works of local Croatian painters and sculptors, like Ivana Pegan, Dubravka Tullio, and Ivo Dimnić

claims.text: Restaurant Pjerin serves breakfast, lunch and dinner on a glass terrace overlooking the Old Town.

findings.quote: Restaurant Pjerin, recognised by the Michelin Guide, is fine‑dining bliss with breakfast, lunch, and dinner served on a sleek glass terrace overlooking the Old Town.

claims.text: Giardino Restaurant sits under century-old pines on an ancient stone terrace.

findings.quote: Giardino Restaurant sits under century‑old pines on an ancient stone terrace

claims.text: Galanto Bar is the hotel's rooftop bar.

findings.quote: Galanto Bar, Dubrovnik’s only rooftop bar

claims.text: Villa Spa treatments combine innovative techniques with Mediterranean natural remedies.

findings.quote: Indulge in exclusive Villa SPA treatments performed with a combination of innovative techniques and Mediterranean natural remedies.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor pool with floor-to-ceiling windows facing the sea.

findings.quote: indoor pool with floor‑to‑ceiling windows opening to views of the ocean

claims.text: Family suites have interconnecting rooms and balcony hot tubs.

findings.quote: spacious family suites featuring interconnecting rooms and balcony hot tubs

claims.text: During the winter of 2024 the hotel underwent a complete renovation by Brazilian studio Studio Arthur Casas.

findings.quote: During the winter of 2024, the hotel underwent another complete renovation by the internationally recognized and awarded Brazilian architect and designer Studio Arthur Casas.

claims.text: The Villa Kolin Residence sits in a secluded part of the hotel, with private access through a small pine forest and a private pool.

findings.quote: situated in a secluded part of the hotel, with private access through a small pine forest and a private pool.

claims.text: Traditional Croatian lace patterns appear in the rooms as wardrobe decoration.

findings.quote: traditional Croatian lace patterns, which can be noticed in the rooms as a wardrobe decoration

claims.text: The suites are named after old Dubrovnik expressions.

findings.quote: Enjoy the luxury and a feeling of total intimacy in our west-oriented suites that are almost merged with nature. Their names are derived from old Dubrovnik expressions to keep the spirit of the Old Town alive

claims.text: The hotel's rocky cliffside beach has jumping platforms into the sea.

findings.quote: the rocky cliffside beach is a big hit for all ages, complete with jumping platforms into the sea

claims.text: The Old Town is a 15-minute walk away, or a private transfer that is part of the hotel's service.

findings.quote: 15-minute walk from the magic of the Old Town, or a quick private transfer (part of the hotel’s service)

claims.text: The beach is naturally rocky and not wheelchair accessible.

findings.quote: The beach, however, remains untouched and naturally rocky as it is cliffside, so it’s not wheelchair accessible

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
